'''Ranste''' was the innermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the pale yellow [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="CW" /> [[Pym]]<ref name="GC" /> in the minor<ref name="CW" /> [[New Plympto system/Legends|New Plympto system]],<ref name="GC" /><ref name="CW" /> located in the [[Outlier systems]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]<ref name="GC" /> within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Ranste was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[New Plympto system/Legends|New Plympto system]], except [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the New Plympto star system in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
